claim: Adult BMI criteria tightened from 30, or 27 with a comorbidity, to 40, or 37 with a comorbidity
source: Wayback captures of the DMAS weight-loss service authorization form: 7/28/2024 shows 30/27, 9/1/2024 shows 40/37
resolution: Confirmed, and the apparent conflict is resolved. The 6/23/2023 DMAS bulletin announces the tighter criteria but states they bind only once a new service authorization form is in use, and the form effective 7/1/2024 still carried the old thresholds. The tightening took effect in 2024 Q3. The implemented rule is BMI above 40, or above 37 with one or more risk factors, which is not the 40 or 35-with-two-conditions the bulletin announced. Both events are now in state_coverage_events.csv.
notes: Conflicts with the 2023-06-23 event row in state_coverage_events.csv, which reports 40, or 35 with two chronic conditions, from the JCHC report. Both cannot be right. Obtain the DMAS memo that changed the form. Outstanding: the DMAS memo issuing the new form, to pin the effective date.
